title: GolgiFold uses AlphaFold predictions to map more than 1,800 Golgi protein complexes
summary: GolgiFold integrates AlphaFold-based predictions of Golgi protein-protein interactions with crosslinking, blue-native proteomics of Golgi organelles and large-scale in silico screens, presenting more than 1,800 predicted pairwise and multisubunit complexes. Biochemical experiments confirmed newly predicted contacts, including a COG1-COG8 interface and an unanticipated COPA-RER1 interface. Only the abstract was reviewed, and the number of interfaces tested is not stated.
ai_technology: AlphaFold-based structure prediction of pairwise and multisubunit protein complexes
organization: Harvard University; Aligning Science Across Parkinson's; Vrije Universiteit Amsterdam

evidence.tested: Biochemical confirmation of selected predicted interfaces, with crosslinking and blue-native proteomics support.
evidence.unknown: How many predicted complexes are correct overall and how many interfaces were tested; full text not reviewed.
evidence.ai_role: AlphaFold predictions generated the interaction map and the specific interface hypotheses.
